program.name: seaquest-one-diver-supply-v1
program.guidance: Seaquest rule, re-evaluated every four frames. Player is kind=player, x=bbox[0], y=bbox[1]; center adds half width/height. Priority 1: unavailable objects or missing player -> NOOP. Priority 2: y<=46 and oxygen_raw<60 -> FIRE until refilled. Priority 3: at y>46, carried_divers==6 OR (carried_divers>=1 and oxygen_raw<=20) -> UPFIRE. Surfacing with zero divers loses a submarine according to the game manual, so collect a diver before returning. Priority 4: SEEK only if carried_divers==0 and at least one kind=diver is visible. Target the diver with minimum Manhattan center distance, first listed on ties. If target center y is more than 5 below player center y -> DOWNFIRE; more than 5 above -> UPFIRE; otherwise center x more than 5 right -> RIGHTFIRE, more than 5 left -> LEFTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. Collect by contact. Priority 5, HUNT when not seeking: y<86 -> DOWNFIRE; y>100 -> UPFIRE. In 86..100 find the nearest shark/enemy_submarine within 12 pixels of player center y. If it is left and facing right -> LEFTFIRE; if right and facing left -> RIGHTFIRE; otherwise FIRE. Oxygen with zero divers is an urgent collection problem, not permission to surface empty. All 18 actions remain available. FIRE is horizontal in the facing direction; moving horizontally also changes facing. Boxes/identities remain provisional. Do not treat inferred events as observed rewards.

action_criteria.NOOP: Object state is unavailable or no player object exists. Wait for active observations.
action_criteria.FIRE: Active player: wait at y<=46 while oxygen_raw<60. Otherwise, after return priority, either the sought diver is within 5 pixels on both center axes, or hunting depth is 86..100 and the nearest same-lane enemy is already faced or absent. Stay and shoot.
action_criteria.UP: Outside this six-action target rule. Select only if none of NOOP, FIRE, UPFIRE, DOWNFIRE, LEFTFIRE or RIGHTFIRE applies.

action_criteria.UPFIRE: Active, not waiting for surface refill. First return upward if y>46 and (carried_divers==6 OR (carried_divers>=1 and oxygen_raw<=20)). Otherwise, if seeking a diver, its center y is more than 5 pixels above player center y. If not seeking, player y>100. Fire during ascent.
action_criteria.RIGHTFIRE: Active, not refilling/returning. If seeking, diver center y is within 5 pixels and diver center x is more than 5 pixels right of player center. Otherwise at hunting depth 86..100, nearest same-lane enemy is right but player.facing is left. Move right and fire.
action_criteria.LEFTFIRE: Active, not refilling/returning. If seeking, diver center y is within 5 pixels and diver center x is more than 5 pixels left of player center. Otherwise at hunting depth 86..100, nearest same-lane enemy is left but player.facing is right. Move left and fire.
action_criteria.DOWNFIRE: Active, not surface-refilling or returning. If seeking a diver, its center y is more than 5 pixels below player center y. If not seeking, player y<86. Fire during descent.
action_criteria.UPRIGHTFIRE: Outside this six-action target rule. Select only if none of NOOP, FIRE, UPFIRE, DOWNFIRE, LEFTFIRE or RIGHTFIRE applies.
action_criteria.UPLEFTFIRE: Outside this six-action target rule. Select only if none of NOOP, FIRE, UPFIRE, DOWNFIRE, LEFTFIRE or RIGHTFIRE applies.

action_criteria.DOWNLEFTFIRE: Outside this six-action target rule. Select only if none of NOOP, FIRE, UPFIRE, DOWNFIRE, LEFTFIRE or RIGHTFIRE applies.
